summary: systemd_service scope (system, user, global) and state; user scope needs a running user dbus reachable via XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, and reloaded starts a stopped unit.
questions: How do I control a systemd --user unit?
Why does systemd_service fail with no such file for the bus?

answer_card.title: systemd_service scope and state
answer_card.answer_md:
- `scope`: `system`/`user`/`global`; user needs dbus + `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`
- `state`: `started`, `stopped` (idempotent); `restarted`, `reloaded` (always run; reloaded starts if stopped)
